I can't compute this exactly here, so this is an estimate.

The number of digits of $p\#$ is $\lfloor \theta(p)/\ln 10\rfloor + 1$, where $\theta(p)=\sum_{q\le p}\ln q$. Since $\theta(x)\approx x$, the digit count is about $843301/\ln 10 \approx 366241$.

Chebyshev's function runs below $x$ by roughly $\sqrt{x}$ at this scale. Checking known values, $\theta(10^3)\approx 956$, $\theta(10^4)\approx 9896$, and $\theta(10^5)\approx 99685$ all fit $x-\theta(x)\approx\sqrt{x}$. For $x=843301$, $\sqrt{x}\approx 918$, so $\theta\approx 842383$. Then

$$\frac{842383}{\ln 10}\approx 365842.3,$$

which gives about $365843$ digits. The uncertainty in the correction term is a few hundred digits, so the true value is probably within a few hundred of this estimate.

ANSWER: 365843
